android.desc:
Stay on top of the world — one swipe at a time 🌍

InSnaps delivers real-time global news across conflicts, diplomacy, trade, military, elections, migration, and more — all in a fast, swipe-first feed personalized to your country and interests.

⭐ YOUR PERSONALIZED NEWS FEED
Articles from 80+ verified sources — BBC, Reuters, Al Jazeera, The Guardian, and dozens more — enriched with images, summaries, and original links. Scored by recency, relevance, and your interests so the most important stories surface first.

⭐ INTERACTIVE CONFLICT MAP
Explore active conflicts worldwide on a 3D globe with real-time pins, timelines, and casualty data sourced from UCDP, Wikipedia, and ReliefWeb.

⭐ VIDEO NEWS FROM TOP CHANNELS
Curated YouTube videos from 50+ verified news and analysis channels — CNN, DW, Caspian Report, TLDR News, and more — woven into your feed.

⭐ LISTEN TO ARTICLES
Turn on feed audio and hear headlines read aloud as you swipe — hands-free news while commuting, cooking, or working out.

⭐ NEWS GAMES
Test your knowledge with Complete the News (fill the missing headline) and Guess the History (match events to years). Track your high scores.

⭐ STORIES & TOPICS
Dive deeper into Finance & Sanctions, Military & Defense, Diplomacy, Elections, Human Rights, Disinformation, and 15+ topic feeds. Instagram-style story cards for quick visual updates.

⭐ TODAY IN HISTORY
Learn what happened on this day — major events, conflicts, and turning points throughout history.

⭐ SHARE BEAUTIFULLY
Share articles as clean visual cards to WhatsApp, X (Twitter), and more. Pro users get ad-free share cards.

⭐ COMMUNITY EDITORIALS
Pro members can submit opinion pieces, analyses, and policy drafts — reviewed and featured in the feed.

⭐ 11 LANGUAGES
Full UI in English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, and Hebrew.

⭐ INSNAPS PRO
Unlimited swipes, ad-free experience, unlimited article audio, sync across devices, editorial submissions, and clean share cards. Less than a coffee a month.

For students, analysts, finance professionals, and anyone who cares about the world.

quotes.text:
A war starts and oil prices move the same day. Sanctions hit and shipping routes reroute. A summit fails and defense budgets surge. But to follow all of this, you need Reuters open for conflicts, Bloomberg for sanctions, Jane's for military, and three more tabs for diplomacy and trade. I got frustrated and built the app I wanted — InSnaps. It's a single feed that covers geopolitics across five domains: Conflicts — active wars, insurgencies, border disputes, ceasefires (25+ tracked with timelines, involved parties, casualty data) Finance & Sanctions — sanctions regimes, commodity shocks, forex, energy markets Military & Weapons — arms deals, defense spending, cyber warfare, nuclear developments Diplomacy — summits, UN activity, peace processes, alliances Trade & Supply — tariffs, shipping routes, energy pipelines, semiconductors, food security Every article is tagged by domain so you instantly see the category. The feed is personalized by country — a user in Germany sees different geopolitical relevance than one in India or Brazil.
Free, no paywall: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.prakshaappthree.appthree&hl=en_IN

Solo developer from India, no funding, no team. ~400 MAU, ~95 DAU, growing organically. Reddit, Twitter has been my best channel so far.

Happy to answer questions about the architecture, data pipeline, or the geopolitics niche
